name: Evaluation, Testing & Optimization semantic-family reconciliation
methodology: Preserve each evaluation lifecycle decision as its own competency rather than collapsing them into a generic evaluation family. A/B testing, regression gating, failure diagnosis, production feedback, and release thresholds test different decisions even when the same quality metrics appear.
crossDomainBoundary: D4 owns evaluation design, test evidence, diagnosis, optimization, and release gates. D6 remains separate when metrics are being communicated to stakeholders, used to negotiate expectations, or tied to sponsorship/adoption rather than used to design or operate the evaluation system.
contentMutationPolicy: Metadata/selection reconciliation only; no question text is changed in this PR.
